article.title: Property attached before judgment not to be re-attached in execution of decree.
article.content: Where property is under attachment by virtue of the provisions of this order decree is subsequently passed in favour of the plaintiff, it shall not be necessary upon an application for execution of such decree to apply for a re-attachment of the property.
article.html:
11Property attached before judgment not to be re-attached in execution of decree.

Order 38, Rule 11

Where property is under attachment by virtue of the provisions of this order decree is subsequently passed in favour of the plaintiff, it shall not be necessary upon an application for execution of such decree to apply for a re-attachment of the property.
